note: Upstream text the site paraphrases. Regenerate with `pnpm bless` after updating the copy on the page to match.
rules: Use 2 spaces per indent level (or set a custom width with `-i N`)
Blank lines are not allowed in piped/heredoc input
Paths must be relative — `/`, `~`, and `..` are not allowed
Directories can: end with `/` or be inferred automatically from indentation
Skel creates files relative to the current directory
